name: rentprog
description: Read-only access to your RentProg rental-fleet data (bookings, clients, cars, schedule, debts, money) for AI agents via MCP, plus five ready-made skills: morning brief, debtors, fleet load, client dossier, period summary.

api_token.title: RentProg personal agent key
api_token.description: Issued in RentProg → Profile → “AI agent keys”. Starts with rpa_. Acts on your behalf and sees exactly what you see.

api_url.title: RentProg MCP endpoint
api_url.description: Default is production (https://rentprog.net/mcp). Staging: https://rentprog.pro/mcp. Local dev stand: http://localhost:3155/mcp.
